title: Engineer, Software Test Automation
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

Preferred to have a graduate or pos-graduate degree in Engineering/Science.

The selected Software QA Engineer will join a world-class software team to plan, manage, execute, and report results for all qualification activities for the PoR/team. He/She will be trained to be an effective team player and leader that will be responsible for the quality of all released products. He/She will be a strong process advocate with an acute attention to detail and desire to continually improve the Qualification process. He/She must be able to partner with other functional teams to resolve quality issues quickly.

**Key Responsibilities Include:**
---------------------------------

* Play role of **full stack test engineer for software of KLA Products**
* Qualification of new and existing products and features (functional/requirements based, regression, performance, reliability). This includes designing and qualifying, publishing results and recommendations in the form of training material, best known methods
* Ability to understand and develop test cases for products that use Deep Learning or machine learning Algorithms.
* Ability to technically interact with Algorithms, System Engineering, Application Engineering, Marketing and Manufacturing, Customer Support team for various requirements across the globe. Interact with cross locational teams.
* Automate the test cases and make them part of the CI pipeline for automatic execution
* Participate in all stages of software development including deployment/trouble shooting at customer sites. Represent SQE team in product life cycle and key program meetings

Travel to customer fabrication and MFG facilities to understand the system and its sub-systems, customer use cases, for deploying SW and troubleshooting.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree or work experience of 0-2 years , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1-3 years

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  
  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

  

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Senior Automation Engineer – Power Platform & RPA (UiPath / PL-500)
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**

RPA and Microsoft Power Platform Developer. You will lead the design, development, and enhancement of enterprise automation solutions across a hybrid technology stack combining RPA (UiPath or Microsoft) and the Microsoft Power Platform. In this role, you will bridge business processes and technical architecture by building scalable Cloud Flows, Power Apps, and Dataverse integrations while ensuring backend dependencies and automated workflows remain robust and high-performing.

  

**What you will do**

* **Solution Development & Maintenance:** Build end-to-end automation products and enhance existing projects using a hybrid stack of RPA (UiPath/Microsoft) and Power Platform tools.
* **Power Platform Engineering:** Design, implement, and optimize Microsoft Power Automate flows, Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), and Dataverse-backed components.
* **API & Data Integration:** Architect high-performance Cloud Flows leveraging REST API integrations, JSON manipulation, XPath expressions, and Dataverse APIs.
* **Data Layer Management:** Write and fine-tune complex SQL and FetchXML queries for data validation, complex logic handling, and workflow troubleshooting.
* **Platform Operations & Upgrades:** Proactively manage backend dependencies, data connections, and environmental configurations; deploy version updates, patches, and runtime upgrades with minimal disruption.
* **Agile Collaboration & Delivery:** Work alongside Agile PMs and Engineering Leads in Scrum or Kanban setups to clear technical blockers and remediate runtime errors.
* **Technical Documentation:** Maintain comprehensive workflow architecture diagrams, technical logic documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required skills and Experience**

* **Experience Level:** 7+ years in automation operations and software/technology development, including at least 4 years of dedicated hands-on experience with RPA tools (UiPath or Microsoft) and/or Power Platform.
* **Power Platform & Scripting:** Expert proficiency in Power Automate Online, Model-driven Apps, Dataverse architecture, and TypeScript/JavaScript.
* **Data & Querying:** Advanced proficiency writing and optimizing SQL, FetchXML, and Dataverse API calls.
* **Integration Expertise:** In-depth knowledge of RESTful services, JSON schema structures, and advanced expressions/XPath for data transformation.
* **Agile & Problem Solving:** Proven track record in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments resolving complex runtime failures, configuration bottlenecks, and environment issues.
* **Mandatory Certification (at least one):** PL-400: Microsoft Power Platform Developer Associate **OR** PL-500: Microsoft Certified: Power Automate RPA Developer Associate

  

**Preferred skills and Experience**

* **Secondary Microsoft Credential:** Holding both PL-400 and PL-500 certifications.
* **RPA Vendor Credentials:** Automation Developer Professional certification from major platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism.
* **AI-Assisted Development:** GH-300: GitHub Copilot certification (or willingness to obtain within 3 months of joining).

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Quality and Automation Engineer 3
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.  
**Job Summary**

Comcast Business offers technological solutions ranging from Ethernet, internet, and WiFi connectivity to voice, television, and managed Enterprise solutions to power businesses of all sizes to perform better. From small businesses to mid-market and large Enterprise organizations, Comcast Business serves business customers across the country. Powered by an advanced, Gig-speed network and backed by 24/7 technical support, Comcast Business is one of the largest contributors to the growth of Comcast Cable. The organization is the nation’s largest cable provider to small and mid-size businesses and has emerged as a force in the Enterprise market, recognized by leading industry associations as one of the fastest growing providers of Ethernet services." Comcast Business IT is an organization within Comcast’s Technology and Product Division and largely located on the east coast (greater Philadelphia and the DC area). We own the IT applications and infrastructure supporting the Comcast Business serving large scale enterprise customers, mid market, small and medium business. Job Summary We are seeking an SDET Engineer with strong technical skills to design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions. The ideal candidate will contribute to building scalable, reliable, and maintainable test assets that help release confidence and reduce manual testing effort. In this role, you will work under guidance on well-defined testing initiatives while independently delivering automation components, test suites, and validation assets. You will collaborate with developers and architects to ensure high-quality software delivery.

**Job Description**

As part of the Comcast Business IT (BIT) organization, you will collaborate with product owners, architects, developers, and testers to deliver prioritized quality initiatives. You will help build a robust test automation foundation that supports faster releases, improved defect detection, and greater operational confidence.

**Test Automation Development**

As an SDET Engineer, you will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of automation assets across the testing lifecycle.

**Automation and Frameworks**

* Build and maintain automated test cases using ATF and other test automation frameworks.
* Develop and execute API test collections using Bruno or similar tools.
* Contribute to creation and expansion of golden regression test suites.
* Support smoke, sanity, regression, and end-to-end automation coverage.

**Quality Engineering**

* Design reusable test assets for ServiceNow workflows, integrations, and UI scenarios.
* Validate functional behavior across application and platform changes.
* Support defect triage and root cause analysis with developers and QA teams.
* Improve test coverage, stability, and execution efficiency.

**Technical Contribution & Collaboration**

* Collaborate with senior engineers, architects, and stakeholders to understand requirements and test strategy.
* Follow established automation standards, naming conventions, and framework guidelines.
* Participate in code reviews, test reviews, and quality checkpoints.
* Contribute to documentation for test assets, execution steps, and coverage gaps.

**Operations and Release Support**

* Support release readiness through automated regression validation.
* Assist in maintaining dependable test pipelines and execution schedules.
* Troubleshoot test failures and environmental issues with guidance.
* Help ensure testing aligns with performance, security, and reliability expectations.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to reduce manual testing through automation.
* Contribute to reuse of test components, data sets, and validation patterns.
* Stay current on automation tooling, ServiceNow testing capabilities, and QA best practices.

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in QA, test automation, or software engineering.
* 2–3 years of hands-on automation experience with test frameworks or API testing tools.
* Experience with ATF, API collections, Bruno/Playwright automation testing, regression automation, and defect validation preferred
* Exposure to ServiceNow testing and enterprise application workflows preferred
* Exposure to Agile development practices preferred

**Preferred Certifications**

title: PLC Automation Engineer
description:
About Our Company

We are an emerging technology company focused on Industrial IoT, smart manufacturing, factory automation, and manufacturing digitization.

Our solutions integrate industrial machines, PLCs, sensors, control panels, and IoT gateways with software platforms to enable real-time machine monitoring, production tracking, energy monitoring, and data-driven manufacturing.

We are looking for a versatile, hands-on engineer who can work across industrial automation, electrical control panels, embedded systems, and IoT communication.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. PLC Programming, HMI & SCADA**

\* Develop, program, and troubleshoot industrial PLC systems.

\* Work with Siemens, Mitsubishi, Delta, Omron, or equivalent PLC platforms.

\* Develop and configure HMI screens and SCADA applications.

\* Integrate PLCs with sensors, actuators, VFDs, motors, and other industrial equipment.

\* Implement machine logic, alarms, interlocks, production counters, and machine-status monitoring.

**2. Electrical Control Panel Design & Assembly**

\* Design, assemble, wire, and test industrial electrical control panels and PLC panels.

\* Prepare electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, and bills of materials.

\* Select and integrate MCBs/MCCBs, contactors, relays, SMPS units, terminal blocks, PLCs, VFDs, and protection devices.

\* Perform cable termination, ferruling, panel testing, and electrical troubleshooting.

\* Support machine installation, commissioning, and panel modification at customer sites.

**3. Industrial IoT & Machine Connectivity**

\* Integrate industrial PLCs and machines with IoT gateways and cloud-based platforms.

\* Work with Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP, RS485, and Ethernet communication.

\* Understand MQTT and HTTP/REST API communication for transferring machine data to servers.

\* Configure gateways to collect machine-running status, production counts, alarms, energy data, and other industrial parameters.

\* Troubleshoot communication issues between PLCs, gateways, and server applications.

**4. Embedded Systems & Firmware**

\* Understand microcontrollers such as STM32 and other embedded platforms.

\* Develop, modify, or troubleshoot embedded C/C++ firmware.

\* Work with GPIO, digital inputs/outputs, UART, RS485, Ethernet, and relevant communication interfaces.

\* Assist in developing firmware for Industrial IoT gateways and communicating with PLCs and servers.

\* Perform hardware testing, firmware debugging, and prototype validation.

**5. Testing, Deployment & Documentation**

\* Conduct factory acceptance testing, integration testing, and on-site commissioning.

\* Troubleshoot hardware, firmware, PLC, and communication issues.

\* Coordinate with the software development team to integrate machine data with dashboards and backend APIs.

\* Prepare technical documentation, I/O lists, wiring diagrams, PLC backups, test reports, and installation guides.

**Required Skills**

\* Hands-on experience with PLC programming and industrial automation.

\* Practical knowledge of HMI and SCADA configuration.

\* Experience in industrial control panel wiring and electrical troubleshooting.

\* Understanding of industrial communication protocols, particularly Modbus RTU/TCP and RS485.

\* Knowledge of IoT gateways and machine-to-server communication.

\* Basic practical knowledge of embedded C/C++ and microcontrollers.

\* Understanding of MQTT, HTTP, or REST API communication.

\* Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and documentation skills.

\* Willingness to work at manufacturing sites and travel when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.

Experience with STM32 or similar microcontrollers.

Familiarity with Ethernet-based industrial communication and cloud-connected devices.

Knowledge of OPC UA, industrial networking, VFDs, and industrial sensors.

Experience integrating factory machines with IoT dashboards or production-monitoring systems.

**What We Offer**

Opportunity to work on complete industrial automation and IoT projects.

Hands-on involvement in developing and deploying Industrial IoT gateway solutions.

Exposure to PLCs, electrical panels, embedded systems, and software integration.

Opportunity to take ownership of technical projects and grow with an emerging technology company.

Application: Candidates should share their resume and details of their PLC projects, control panel work, IoT integrations, or embedded systems experience.

Candidates with practical project experience will be preferred over candidates with theoretical knowledge alone.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Senior QA  Automation Engineer
description:
**About the Company:**

Edgar Efile Solutions Pvt. Ltd is one of the prominent, energetic, and fastest growing companies in the industry.

The company was established in the year 2013 and playing a major role in providing financial reporting service like XBRL, Edgar and Typesetting services with 100% focus on quality within a strict timeline to US Clients.

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our team and help us deliver high\-quality software products. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated and AI\-driven testing solutions to ensure the functionality, performance, scalability, and reliability of our web applications. You will also collaborate with software developers, product managers, and other QA engineers to identify and resolve defects, improve testing processes, implement best practices, and drive intelligent test automation initiatives. 

**Responsibilities** 

· Develop test cases, test plans, test scripts, test data sets, or test procedures 

based on business requirements. 

· Report results of automated tests to development teams so that defects can be addressed before production release.

· Conduct post release audits to ensure that software is functioning properly in 

production environment.

· Perform load and performance tests using tools like JMeter or LoadRunner to check how well the system works and ensure scalability under high\-demand conditions.

· Perform manual testing on applications to identify bugs or defects in features.

· Coordinate with development teams to ensure that new features are thoroughly tested before deployment.

· Documenting acceptance criteria in user stories and tasks. 

**Requirements** 

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field 5\+ years of experience in QA automation engineering.

· Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter.

· Experience with automation tools and frameworks such as **Selenium,**

**Playwright \& Cucumber**.

·Experience with web and mobile testing technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, RESTful APIs, or JSON. 

· Experience with version control tools such as Git, SVN, or Mercurial is desirable.

· Experience with continuous integration tools such as Jenkins is plus.

· Experience with agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.

· Excellent presentation, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills, with a strong attention to detail, quality, and accuracy is essential.

· Experience with AI\-driven testing methodologies and tools, including intelligent test automation, **automated test case generation**, self\-healing test scripts, defect prediction, **smart regression testing**, and AI\-based test analytics, is an added advantage.

Job Type: Full\-time

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
